{{RV|type=command

|game1= tkoh
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= RTD

|descr= Set the throttle for the given engine(s) of a helicopter.

|s1= helicopterRTD [[setThrottleRTD]] [value, engineIndex]

|p1= helicopterRTD: [[Object|ObjectRTD]] - helicopter

|p2= value: [[Number]] - throttle level, range 0..1
* throttle 0: fully closed
* throttle ~0.15: average flight idle
* throttle 1: full

|p3= engineIndex: [[Number]] - engine index
* engine index 0: engine #1
* engine index 1: engine #2
* engine index 2: engine #3
* engine index -1: all engines

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>vehicle player setThrottleRTD [0.5, 1];</sqf>

|seealso= [[throttleRTD]]
}}
